in_marathi.name: Prosenjit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Master of the senses
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prosenjit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Prosenjit means one who has complete mastery over his senses and emotions. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'prosana' which means 'sense' and 'jit' which means 'mastery'.

in_bengali.name: Prosenjit
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Master of the senses
in_bengali.long_meaning: Prosenjit একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Prosenjit means one who has complete mastery over his senses and emotions. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'prosana' which means 'sense' and 'jit' which means 'mastery'.
